- Charger closes S3 and S4 to supply low-voltage auxiliary power to the Vehicle
- Charger also start perform insulation check on its side + cable
- Charger and Vehicle send initial handshake messages(protocol charger & battery general information)

div.div:
- Charger and vehicle exchange charging session setup parameters
- Vehicle close its side DCFC contactors, start insulation monitoring and signal it's ready
- Charger check the vehicle side HV Batt voltage, ensure system is ready

- Both vehicle and charger enter charging loop communication and power transmission
